ctx.x: Bom (unintelligible) called the Bandville Club, the Bom Bandville Club. So he had the job at the Bandville, so he took his band out of the Nest Club and gave it to his -- gave the group to Cliff Jackson, let -- Jackson formed the group to play in the Nest Club. So Cliff picked his group, and I was with Cliff. Cliff had almost as good a band as Snowden did. He and Snowden were both from Washington, D. C. Well, Snowden was very impressed with the group, so Cliff said -- he asked Cliff, said, what are you going to…
